high_anisotropy.rationale: Anisotropic surfaces require directional point sources to reveal the directional grain of the highlights.

high_transmission.rationale: Translucent materials require rear illumination to reveal subsurface scattering and separation.

dense_pile_surface.rationale: Pile fabrics absorb direct light; texture is only visible at the terminator line or via grazing rim lights.

high_metallic_content.rationale: Metals require contrast to read as metallic; flat lighting makes metals look matte or grey.

low_mass_fabric.rationale: Low mass fabrics move easily with air currents, requiring fast shutter speeds to freeze motion, unless intentional blur is requested.
